buildings.subtitle: About · Me
buildings.intro:
I am a social science major turned data professional. I have always been a lover of all things tech, and had tried to
become more of a software builder. I have worked in government agencies, large corporations, small startups and big tech
companies, and is a returning analytics consultant. With the advent of GenAI, it seems like everyone can be a builder as
well. Using this space as my personal creative outlet.
